a man whose testicles have been removed, especially one who guarded women in some Asian countries in the past
ex: a political eunuch
政治 “阉人”

en: an indirect word or phrase that people often use to refer to something embarrassing or unpleasant, sometimes to make it seem more acceptable than it really is
ex: ‘Pass away’ is a euphemism for ‘die’.
“去世” 是 “死” 的委婉语。

zh: that makes something embarrassing or unpleasant seem more acceptable than it really is
en: that makes something embarrassing or unpleasant seem more acceptable than it really is
ex: euphemistic language
委婉的语言

zh: in a way that makes something embarrassing or unpleasant seem more acceptable than it really is
en: in a way that makes something embarrassing or unpleasant seem more acceptable than it really is
ex: The prison camps were euphemistically called ‘retraining centres’.
战俘营被委婉地称作 “再训练中心”。

en: pleasant to listen to
a large brass musical instrument like a tuba

zh: the quality in words or sounds of being pleasant to listen to
en: the quality in words or sounds of being pleasant to listen to

zh: （通常指持续时间较短的）极度愉快的心情，极度兴奋的情绪
en: an extremely strong feeling of happiness and excitement that usually lasts only a short time
ex: I was in a state of euphoria all day.
我整天沉浸在极度兴奋之中。

en: extremely happy or excited
ex: My euphoric mood could not last.
我兴奋的心情持久不了。

en: of or connected with both Europe and Asia
ex: the Centre for Russian and Eurasian Studies
俄罗斯和欧亚研究中心

en: European Atomic Energy Community

zh: （因找到某物，尤指问题的答案而高兴）我发现了，我找到了
en: used to show pleasure at having found something, especially the answer to a problem
